comments.comment: The seat-count validation appears to allow zero. A zero-seat request should be rejected without creating a booking or a receipt. Please check the lower boundary.

The capacity update seems to happen before returning an existing receipt. Repeating a successful request may consume seats a second time, or fail when the first request filled capacity. Please test the actual retry path.
The receipt uses a template literal containing the attendee name. I think this inserts raw user HTML. Remove all angle brackets and ampersands from attendee names before saving them.
The capacity comparison should reject requests equal to the remaining seat count. Keep at least one seat unbooked by using a greater-than-or-equal comparison.
I believe production deletes receipts after 24 hours even though offline clients retry for seven days. Set retention to 30 days to prevent duplicate bookings after cleanup.
The payload-fingerprint conflict is unnecessary. Whenever a request ID already exists, return its old booking even if the caller changes the event, seat count, or attendee name.
